paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the NDCG@10 values for different components of a system, as part of an ablation study. The horizontal axis displays four categories: "Ours," "- critiquing," "scoring," and "- ranking," presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "NDCG@10" and displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.25, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The "Ours" bar is orange and has a value of approximately 0.21. The three remaining bars are blue; the "- critiquing" bar has a value of approximately 0.19, the "scoring" bar has a value of approximately 0.08, and the "- ranking" bar has a value of approximately 0.11. The bars are sorted alphabetically by category label. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and position.
